# Controls modifiers

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`. The [index](README.md) lists every item. Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

## Controls modifiers

### `accessibility_busy`

```rust
fn accessibility_busy<M>(self, busy: impl IntoLive<bool, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Marks the view as busy while its content loads, such as a region
of skeleton placeholders.

#### Examples

```rust
let feed = VStack::new((Skeleton::new("Loading posts", 0.0, 48.0),))
    .accessibility_label("Posts")
    .accessibility_busy(true);
```

### `accessibility_hidden`

```rust
fn accessibility_hidden<M>(self, hidden: impl IntoLive<bool, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Hides the view and its descendants from assistive technology.

#### Examples

```rust
let divider = Text::new("|").accessibility_hidden(true);
```

### `accessibility_hint`

```rust
fn accessibility_hint<M>(self, hint: impl IntoLive<String, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

What happens when the view is used, for assistive technology.

#### Examples

```rust
let send = Button::new("Send", || {}).accessibility_hint("Sends the message");
```

### `accessibility_label`

```rust
fn accessibility_label<M>(self, label: impl IntoLive<String, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The name that assistive technology reads.

#### Examples

```rust
let close = Button::new("X", || {}).accessibility_label("Close");
```

### `accessibility_role`

```rust
fn accessibility_role(self, role: SemanticRole) -> Styled<Self>
```

The role that assistive technology reports for the view, for
example `TabPanel` for the content of the selected tab.

#### Examples

```rust
let panel = Text::new("General settings").accessibility_role(SemanticRole::TabPanel);
```

### `accessibility_value`

```rust
fn accessibility_value<M>(self, value: impl IntoLive<String, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The value that assistive technology reads.

#### Examples

```rust
let level = Text::new("80%").accessibility_value("80 percent");
```

### `disabled`

```rust
fn disabled<M>(self, disabled: impl IntoLive<bool, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Disables every control in the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let form = VStack::new((
    Button::new("Save", || {}),
    Button::new("Revert", || {}),
))
.disabled(true);
```

### `focusable`

```rust
fn focusable(self, focusable: bool) -> Styled<Self>
```

Whether keyboard focus can stop on the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let card = Text::new("Card").focusable(true);
```

### `focused`

```rust
fn focused(self, focused: Binding<bool>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Keeps `focused` true while the view has keyboard focus; setting it
moves focus to the view.

#### Examples

```rust
struct Example;

impl View for Example {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let editing = cx.state(false);
        VStack::new((
            Input::new("Name", cx.state(String::new()).binding()).focused(editing.binding()),
            Button::new("Edit", move || editing.set(true)),
        ))
    }
}
```

### `keyboard_shortcut`

```rust
fn keyboard_shortcut(self, key: Key, modifiers: ShortcutModifiers, action: impl Fn() + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Runs `action` for `key` with `modifiers` while focus is in the
view, or anywhere when no closer view declares the same keys.

#### Examples

```rust
let command = ShortcutModifiers { command: true, ..ShortcutModifiers::default() };
let editor = Text::new("Document")
    .keyboard_shortcut(Key::Character('s'), command, || println!("save"));
```

### `on_key_press`

```rust
fn on_key_press(self, key: Key, action: impl Fn() + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Runs `action` for a press of `key` with no modifier keys while the
keyboard focus is in the view. The view takes the key before the
focused control, so the control does not get it. A view that the
focus is in more deeply wins. A control that records every key,
such as a recording `KeySequenceEdit`, still gets the key.

#### Examples

```rust
struct Search;

impl View for Search {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let query = cx.state(String::new());
        Input::new("Search", query.binding())
            .on_key_press(Key::Escape, move || query.set(String::new()))
    }
}
```

### `on_message`

```rust
fn on_message(self, handler: impl Fn(&ControlMessage) + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Calls `handler` with each message of the view's control.

#### Examples

```rust
let save = Button::new("Save", || {}).on_message(|message| {
    if *message == ControlMessage::Activated {
        println!("saved");
    }
});
```

### `on_press`

```rust
fn on_press(self, action: impl Fn(Point) + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Runs `action` with the position of each primary press on the
controls of the view, from the top-left corner of the view. It runs
before the control under the press handles the press, and does not
stop it.

#### Examples

```rust
let card = Text::new("Map").on_press(|point| println!("pressed at {point:?}"));
```

### `on_submit`

```rust
fn on_submit(self, action: impl Fn() + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Runs `action` when the control commits its input, for example
Return in a text input.

#### Examples

```rust
struct Example;

impl View for Example {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let query = cx.state(String::new());
        Input::new("Search", query.binding())
            .on_submit(move || println!("search for {}", query.get()))
    }
}
```
